🚀 flowsint | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Visualizing and exploring relationships in Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) data for cybersecurity investigations.
✨ Key Features: • Graph exploration tool • OSINT focused • Ethical investigation • Transparency and verification • Visual, flexible, and extensible
📖 Summary: Flowsint is an open-source OSINT graph exploration tool designed for ethical investigation, transparency, and verification. It provides a modern platform for visual, flexible, and extensible graph-based investigations, primarily for cybersecurity analysts and investigators.
